# linlan-emis (BuddyOne) — Multi-tenant IAM / SSO

> A standalone multi-tenant identity & access management (IAM/SSO) platform built on Spring Boot 3.5.16 + Java 17.
> Provides local-account auth, a standard OAuth2/OIDC authorization server, tenant context, and role-based access.

Key capabilities:
- Authentication: local accounts (BCrypt); third-party federation and OTP/MFA (planned)
- Authorization: standard OAuth2 + OIDC authorization server, issues access/refresh/id_token (JWT, JWKS-verifiable)
- Multi-tenancy: tenant_id kernel + TenantContext + row-level isolation
- Basic roles: role_level (0 主任 / 1 研究员 / 2 访客) as cross-product semantics
- Minimal backend (P0): JJWT issuance, TenantContext, @RequiresRole (fail-closed)

Tech stack: Java 17, Spring Boot 3.5.16, MyBatis 3.0.5, jjwt 0.12.6, Spring Security, spring-authorization-server 1.x, H2/MySQL
Version: 0.1.0
Repository: https://github.com/linlannet/linlan-emis
Related repositories: dsh-java (OAuth2 resource server), dsh-java-desktop (OIDC client), emis-java-backend (reference impl), dsh-java-ontology (tenant/role blueprint)

Modules:
- backend/        emis-backend (Spring Boot app, artifactId emis-backend, v0.1.0)
- test-client/    linlan-emis-test-client (demo OIDC authorization-code client, v0.1.0)
- py-api/         Python API (placeholder)
- frontend/       Web console (placeholder)
- scripts/        bash helpers: package.sh, start-local-jar.sh, start-mysql-jar.sh, verify-oidc.sh
- docs/           01-architecture.md, 02-user-tenant-model.md, 03-oauth2-authorization-server.md, 04-permission-model.md

Build (backend):  cd backend && mvn -q -DskipTests clean package
Run (local/H2):   ./scripts/start-local-jar.sh --build
  URL: http://localhost:8080
  Login: POST /api/auth/login { userName, password }
  Default accounts: admin/admin123 (roleLevel=0), guest/guest123 (roleLevel=2)
  H2 console: http://localhost:8080/h2-console

Docs:

- docs/01-architecture.md ... docs/04-permission-model.md
